svg.title: Osmium-catalyzed syn dihydroxylation: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: Cyclic osmate ester + water / reductive work-up → HOCH2CH2OH + reduced osmium species. Hydrolysis/reductive cleavage of Os–O bonds releases the syn diol; proton relays and exact osmium speciation are grouped.

g.text: Cyclic osmate ester + water / reductive work-up
Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Hydrolysis/reductive cleavage of Os–O bonds releases the syn diol; proton relays and exact osmium speciation
